# Third-party papers: file-specific rights

These original PDFs retain their original authors, copyright notices and licenses. They are not covered by a new repository-wide code license.

Copies marked NC are shared here unchanged for non-commercial research under their original conditions; ND copies are not modified. SA terms remain applicable where specified.

The original authors and full credit lines are retained in each PDF as printed. Exact-version evidence, conditions and third-party exceptions are recorded in `catalogs/paper_permissions.json`.
